## Verdict

Heronry costs least for a team of 15, at $360 per month. It has the highest per-seat rate on the list, but it is the only vendor whose minimum (5 seats) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly 15 seats. Juno Board and Cygnus Flow both bill for seats the team will not use.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $12 | 25 |
| Cygnus Flow | $17 | 50 |
| Heronry | $24 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (15) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger.

- **Heronry:** minimum 5 is below 15, so 15 seats paid. 15 × $24 = **$360 per month**.
- **Juno Board:** minimum 25 exceeds 15, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $12 = **$300 per month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 50 exceeds 15, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $17 = **$850 per month**.

Correction on the ranking: Juno Board is cheapest at $300, $60 below Heronry, despite paying for 10 unused seats. Cygnus Flow is $550 above Juno Board.

**Juno Board costs least, at $300 per month.**

## Risks

The two cheapest options are $60 apart per month, or $720 a year — close enough that any fee outside this price list could reverse the order. Heronry's $360 is honest capacity; Juno Board's $300 buys 25 seats for 15 people, an effective $20 per person against Heronry's $24.

That gap closes as the team grows. At 25 people Juno Board still costs $300 while Heronry costs $600, so Juno Board's lead widens with headcount. Shrinking below 12 people makes Heronry cheaper, since Juno Board's $300 floor is fixed.

Cygnus Flow is not competitive at any size under 50 seats and is not worth quoting at this headcount.

This covers price only. Features, support tiers, and contract terms are not on the price list.
